queries.compute_intervals:
WITH compute_view AS (
    SELECT c.globalTaskId, ROUND(t.endNs - t.startNs) AS duration_ns, n.value AS op_name, type_str.value AS op_type
    FROM COMPUTE_TASK_INFO c
    LEFT JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId = c.globalTaskId
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id = c.name
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS type_str ON type_str.id = c.opType
)
SELECT json_group_array(json_array(t.startNs,t.endNs,t.streamId)) FROM compute_view c JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId=c.globalTaskId
queries.reduce_ops: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(o.opId,o.startNs,o.endNs,o.count,o.connectionId)) FROM COMMUNICATION_OP o JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=o.opType WHERE n.value='hcom_reduceScatter_'
queries.reduce_transport: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(t.startNs,t.endNs,n.value,k.size,t.streamId,k.opId)) FROM COMMUNICATION_TASK_INFO k JOIN COMMUNICATION_OP o ON o.opId=k.opId JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId=k.globalTaskId JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=k.taskType JOIN STRING_IDS a ON a.id=o.opType WHERE a.value='hcom_reduceScatter_'
queries.verified_launches: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(o.opId,h.startNs,h.endNs,h.globalTid)) FROM COMMUNICATION_OP o JOIN STRING_IDS k ON k.id=o.opType JOIN CANN_API h ON h.connectionId=o.connectionId JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=h.name WHERE k.value='hcom_reduceScatter_' AND n.value='launch'
queries.host_scopes: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(CAST(p.startNs AS INTEGER),CAST(p.endNs AS INTEGER),n.value,p.globalTid)) FROM PYTORCH_API p JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=p.name WHERE n.value LIKE 'zero/%' OR n.value LIKE 'gradient_transfer/%'
queries.device_waits: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(t.startNs,t.endNs,t.streamId)) FROM TASK t JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=t.taskType WHERE n.value='EVENT_WAIT'
queries.all_collectives: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(o.opId,o.startNs,o.endNs,n.value)) FROM COMMUNICATION_OP o JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=o.opType
queries.communication_stream_tasks: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(t.startNs,t.endNs,t.streamId,n.value,k.opId)) FROM COMMUNICATION_TASK_INFO k JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId=k.globalTaskId JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=k.taskType

limits: Per-op queue leads overlap across operations; their sums are not elapsed wall time.
EVENT_WAIT indicates a stream dependency but this DB lacks event IDs for its exact producer.
Shared HCCL execution stream and no overlap are observed, not a proof that changing process groups improves training.
